t: You're looking at the BFI IMAX, an IMAX cinema just north of Waterloo station, in the South Bank area. It is owned and run by the British Film Institute. From 2012 until 2022 it was operated by Odeon Cinemas. The architect Bryan Avery designed it. Avery was born in Wallingford in Berkshire and grew up in Lymington in the New Forest. He studied architecture at Leicester College of Art, then took a master's degree in the history and theory of architecture at Essex University. He was awarded an MBE for his work.
